providers.title: Solply Food Supply Trade Index
providers.description: Real-world food-supply settlement data from a franchise ecosystem - executed price and demand indexes, verified by on-chain settlement, sold via x402
providers.use_case: Executed prices and demand trends for real-world food-supply SKUs (not crypto tokens). Every sample is an on-chain settled trade on Solana. For supply-chain price research and procurement negotiation grounding.
